english.title: Candidate/agent print/publish publication promoting election candidate without printer/publisher details on publication
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of an illegal practice in that being

(A)_[a candidate]_
(B)_[an election agent of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..),]_

at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), you published material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure

(C)_[your election]_
(D)_[the election of that candidate]_

at that election when

(E)_[your name and address]_
(F)_[the name and address of the promoter of the material]_
(G)_[the name and address of the person on behalf of whom the material was being published]_

was not included in accordance with regulations, namely **(..SPECIFY REGULATIONS..), imposed by virtue of section 110(7) of the Representation of the People Act 1983 in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 110(2)(b), (10) and (12) and 169 of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see section 176

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
